title: 一年级入学适应四周
nativeSvg:
<svg data-theme="terracotta" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1600 900" width="1600" height="900">
<title>一年级入学适应四周</title>
<g data-md-layer="旅程">
<rect width="1600" height="900" fill="#F3E9DE"/>
<text id="title" x="80" y="110" font-family="'Noto Serif CJK SC','Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',serif" font-size="54" fill="#3B2418" font-weight="900">一年级入学适应四周</text>
<text x="84" y="158" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#7A3A26" font-weight="500">从幼儿园到小学，一周只练一件事</text>
<path d="M80 260 H420 L450 310 L420 360 H80 L110 310 Z" fill="#B5553A"/>
<text x="130" y="302" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="700">第 1 周</text>
<text x="130" y="338" font-family="'Noto Serif CJK SC','Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="900">认识学校</text>
<circle cx="100" cy="424" r="5" fill="#B5553A"/>
<text x="116" y="431" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">找得到教室、厕所、饮水处</text>
<circle cx="100" cy="468" r="5" fill="#B5553A"/>
<text x="116" y="475" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">知道上课铃和下课铃</text>
<path d="M440 260 H780 L810 310 L780 360 H440 L470 310 Z" fill="#C96F4C"/>
<text x="490" y="302" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="700">第 2 周</text>
<text x="490" y="338" font-family="'Noto Serif CJK SC','Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="900">学会整理</text>
<circle cx="460" cy="424" r="5" fill="#C96F4C"/>
<text x="476" y="431" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">自己整理书包和课桌</text>
<circle cx="460" cy="468" r="5" fill="#C96F4C"/>
<text x="476" y="475" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">按课表准备书本</text>
<path d="M800 260 H1140 L1170 310 L1140 360 H800 L830 310 Z" fill="#D98A5F"/>
<text x="850" y="302" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="700">第 3 周</text>
<text x="850" y="338" font-family="'Noto Serif CJK SC','Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="900">适应一节课</text>
<circle cx="820" cy="424" r="5" fill="#D98A5F"/>
<text x="836" y="431" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">从 20 分钟专注慢慢到 40 分钟</text>
<circle cx="820" cy="468" r="5" fill="#D98A5F"/>
<text x="836" y="475" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">举手发言、轮流说话</text>
<path d="M1160 260 H1500 L1530 310 L1500 360 H1160 L1190 310 Z" fill="#E3A57E"/>
<text x="1210" y="302" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="700">第 4 周</text>
<text x="1210" y="338" font-family="'Noto Serif CJK SC','Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" font-weight="900">小小展示会</text>
<circle cx="1180" cy="424" r="5" fill="#E3A57E"/>
<text x="1196" y="431" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">每人展示一件新学会的事</text>
<circle cx="1180" cy="468" r="5" fill="#E3A57E"/>
<text x="1196" y="475" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#3B2418">家长开放日</text>
<line x1="80" y1="560" x2="1500" y2="560" stroke="#7A3A26" stroke-opacity="0.3"/>
<text x="80" y="620" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#7A3A26" font-weight="900">老师</text>
<text x="200" y="620" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#3B2418">每天放学前用一分钟夸具体的进步，例如「今天你自己把水杯放回了原处」。</text>
<text x="80" y="680" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#7A3A26" font-weight="900">家长</text>
<text x="200" y="680" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#3B2418">晚上和孩子一起整理第二天的书包，不替他做；早上提前十分钟出门。</text>
<text x="80" y="740" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#7A3A26" font-weight="900">孩子</text>
<text x="200" y="740" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#3B2418">遇到不会的事，先说「老师，我需要帮忙」。</text>
</g>
</svg>
